question: What should the disciple offer to the guru after completing the worship?
premises: The worship extends fully, up to the directions.
After worship, the disciple honors the guru with gifts.
The offering may include all possessions and even oneself, given with devotion.
inference: Guru worship culminates in generous giving and inward self-offering by the disciple.
plain_english: Having worshiped him in all directions, the disciple should honor him with gifts. With devout awareness, one should give him all that one has and even oneself.
